prompt: Use case: identity-preserve narrative restaging. First inputs canonical identity portraits; next room master is only architectural/palette reference; LAST input is prior scene for cast, approved face morphology and exact task content, NOT a pose to preserve. Preserve each canonical face, adult age, hair, eye/nose/jaw proportions and characteristic accessories. Farah lens anatomical LEFT eye; Demir comms anatomical RIGHT ear; Nazari and Mirza have no eyewear. Balanced stylized adult head/body scale, neither oversized heads nor realistic tiny heads. Clean cel-shaded adventure-comic linework, natural supported anatomy, two arms per character. Restage Farah seated sideways at a lab workbench, chair and torso facing a low sloping instrument display, natural three-quarter face visible from the camera beside the instrument. She looks down at the update loop with a slight questioning brow, not at an audience. Her right hand adjusts the physical slider on the workbench; her left hand holds a stylus poised near the assumed variances on the same console, elbow supported naturally. Remove the upright held presentation tablet. The compact embedded display shows a connected cycle: Predict variance, Compute gain, Correct estimate + variance, then Next reading returning to Predict variance. Each arrow unambiguous. Bottom row labeled Assumed variances: Q = 0.1, R = 1, Initial variance = 1. No invented curves or claim of known ground truth. All lettering and arrows follow the sloping console plane with consistent foreshortening and spacing. Other wall monitors off, lab pillar dark muted sage, aged brass and charcoal, warm olive skin. Preserve exact adult face morphology and balanced head size with a natural neck; two connected arms, distinct shoulders and realistic slider and stylus grips. Work action dominates, no displayed card, no stage-poster framing. Output one full 1536x1024 scene. No text outside genuine work artifacts, no captions, no hero portraits, no camera-facing eye contact or lesson cards.
